Now I want talk about the things I liked about Papertrade launch and think more projects should copy.

1. No imaginary points. You farm the actual tokens without guessing what allocation you would get. Makes the farming process much more transparent and enjoyable.

2. Yield being paid in USDC. This actually gives you the feeling that you own the exchange and share the profits. Personally I prefer this way more to buy and burn method.

3. No crashes. Yes, I know there is a queue system but the platform itself worked flawlessly. Didn't have any issues with loading and stuff.
